conventions: Coordinates: z[3i]=cx_i, z[3i+1]=cy_i, z[3i+2]=theta_i in RADIANS, z[33]=s.  (The A44 brief's 't = tan(theta/2)' is wrong: A37/A22 store the angle itself; verified by evaluating every contact row at z_center, residual < 1e-15.)

Loaded core = 11 squares minus atlas rattler_squares.  Every contact incident to a rattler is dropped; the drop count is recorded and the dropped rows are separately LP-tested for loadability (alarm test).

Fact 0 (PRIMARY convention, docs/proofs/structure_lemmas.md): the contact set of a pair is a point or a segment.  Segment -> 1 edge, 2 rows; point -> 1 edge, 1 row.  Segment/point is decided GEOMETRICALLY, not from the A37 class label: the contact points are the rowspec corners with |t| <= 1/2 + 1e-6 (i.e. lying on the owner's edge segment), clustered at 1e-6.  1 cluster = point contact, 2 clusters = segment contact.

A37 class labels are NOT used for the row count because A37's CORNER-CORNER label conflates two geometries: (a) n_axes_tied = 4, 8 rowspecs, 1 contact point -- a genuine corner-to-corner POINT touch (1 row); (b) n_axes_tied = 2, 4 rowspecs, 2 contact points -- a FLUSH segment contact whose two endpoints are corners of both squares (2 rows; these are exactly the centre-distance-1 pairs that A35/M1b identified as flush).  Across the atlas: 105 A37-FLUSH (2 pts), 56 CC-2axes (2 pts), 16 CC-4axes (1 pt), 224 POINT (1 pt) -- the split is perfectly clean.
The literal brief convention (FLUSH=2, POINT=1, CORNER-CORNER=1 from the A37 label) is reported as a SHADOW count (counts_brief_convention / brief_convention_shadow).
Wall contacts: grouped by (square i, wall w); 1 edge per group, rows = number of distinct corners in the group (2 corners = wall-flush edge, counted in F).

aux (centre-distance) rows are EXCLUDED from the physical count: they are |c_a-c_b|^2 >= 1 incircle surrogates, not contacts, and Fact 0 counts contacts.  They are listed per entry for the Trump reconciliation.
Jacobian row representative: for each contact point, the rowspec branch preferring [V]-safe, then min |t|, then lexicographic (owner, other, edge, corner).  Deterministic.

Jacobian columns = 3 per core square + s (N = 3k+1).  Far-wall rows (x=s, y=s) carry ds coefficient +1; all other rows have zero s-entry.  Analytic float64 gradients, cross-checked against a37_pipeline.jac_at (mpmath interval jets, dps 60): max entrywise difference 5.6e-16.

rank_num [NUM]: float64 SVD, absolute cut sigma > 1e-9 (same cut as A37 classify()).  rank at 1e-11 and 1e-7 also recorded, together with the singular values straddling the cut.  Rank deficiency is never interval-certifiable at a rational approximation of an algebraic point.

FJ LP (lambda0 = 1): A^T lambda = e_s, 0 <= lambda <= 1e6, HiGHS.  e_s is the unit vector in the s column; equivalently the 3k stationarity sums vanish and the far-wall multipliers sum to 1.  loadable iff max lambda_r > 1e-7; forced iff min lambda_r > 1e-7.
